claim_statement: Starship Flight 14 launched on September 28 2026 from Starbase Boca Chica Texas
contradiction_notes: Consensus across all primary and secondary sources.

claim_statement: Flight 14 vehicle configuration consisted of Super Heavy Booster (Stage 1) and Starship Upper Stage (Stage 2) with 9m diameter
contradiction_notes: Standard Starship architecture documented across SpaceX and regulatory filings.

claim_statement: Booster propulsion configuration comprised 33 Raptor engines producing approximately 90.6 MN liftoff thrust
contradiction_notes: Matches SpaceX published Raptor 3 specifications (280 tf sea-level thrust per engine).

claim_statement: Super Heavy Booster executed a controlled descent and soft splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico approximately 7 minutes after liftoff
contradiction_notes: Primary and independent reporting confirm ocean splashdown; no launch tower catch was attempted on this flight.

claim_statement: Hot-staging separation was executed at approximately T+142 seconds with upper stage engine ignition preceding physical disconnect
contradiction_notes: Hot-staging ring venting aerodynamics verified by NASA Ames supercomputing studies.

claim_statement: Super Heavy Booster suffered an early shutdown of one outer Raptor engine during powered ascent but vehicle continued
contradiction_notes: Reported by Reuters and webcast tracking; engine-out capability maintained trajectory.

claim_statement: Starship upper stage carried 26 Starlink V3 direct-to-cell satellites and achieved successful orbital deployment
contradiction_notes: Reported as Starship's first functional payload delivery to Low Earth Orbit.

claim_statement: Starship upper stage suffered a premature shutdown of one Raptor engine during orbital insertion burn
contradiction_notes: Contemporaneous reporting confirms upper stage engine anomaly which impacted mission duration.

claim_statement: Total mission duration was shortened from the planned ~10 hours to approximately 3 hours and 8 minutes due to the propulsion anomaly
contradiction_notes: SpaceX website retains the pre-flight 10h timeline; independent reporters confirm early entry at ~3h.

claim_statement: Starship upper stage executed an early deorbit burn and completed atmospheric reentry terminating in Pacific Ocean splashdown north of Hawaii
contradiction_notes: Confirmed by tracking telemetry and splashdown observation; no intact recovery for reuse.

claim_statement: Starship upper stage dry mass is estimated at approximately 105000 kg and propellant capacity at 1200000 kg
contradiction_notes: Proprietary exact weight is not public; derived from payload capacity and public PR dimensions.

claim_statement: Flight 14 did not achieve intact vehicle recovery or reuse; both stages were expended in ocean splashdowns
contradiction_notes: Crucial truth constraint: no tower catch or intact recovery occurred on Flight 14.

claim_statement: Plume impingement on the booster forward dome during hot separation creates an overpressure pulse of ~4.5 MN for ~0.7 seconds
contradiction_notes: Calculated from NASA Ames HECC CFD simulations on the Pleiades supercomputer.

claim_statement: Atmospheric density profiles follow the 1976 US Standard Atmosphere model up to 1000 km geometric altitude
contradiction_notes: Standard international reference model for atmospheric flight mechanics.

claim_statement: Max dynamic pressure (Max-Q) occurs at approximately T+62 seconds at an altitude of ~13 km with vehicle throttled to 70%
contradiction_notes: Observed in flight commentary and consistent with heavy-lift ascent profiles.

claim_statement: Starlink V3 satellites possess an individual mass of approximately 1750 kg and dimensions of 7m x 3.5m
contradiction_notes: Documented in SpaceX FCC Form 312 direct-to-cell regulatory filings.

claim_statement: Launch azimuth and orbital inclination were approximately 28.5 to 30.0 degrees matching standard Starbase orbital corridors
contradiction_notes: Consistent with FAA Starbase commercial launch license safety zones.

claim_statement: NASA GMAT R2026a EarthMJ2000Eq coordinate frame and JGM-2 gravity model serve as the truth benchmark for orbital propagation
contradiction_notes: Established NASA flight dynamics software standard.

claim_statement: Orbital insertion state target was approximately 200 km x 250 km elliptical low Earth orbit at ~7750 m/s velocity
contradiction_notes: Derived from insertion energy requirements and LEO parking orbit standards.

claim_statement: Starship propellant tank hoop stresses can be analyzed using Roark thin-walled cylinder formulas under 6.0 bar ullage pressure
contradiction_notes: Classical solid mechanics analytical benchmark for FEA verification.

claim_statement: 304L stainless steel exhibits Young modulus of 193 GPa and yield strength of 290 MPa at room temperature
contradiction_notes: Standard metallurgical specification for cryogenic austenitic stainless steel.
